integrity: Two standalone, deterministic, exact-integer checkers plus the complete pencil-incidence proof, with all source files embedded. Finite enumerations prove only the stated finite identities.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact binary-indicator rank by weight census only on the additive group F_5^2; does not classify arbitrary coefficient weights, other finite fields, or spectral conditioning. The rank-nine gap and the three-special-direction structure have prior literature coverage; neither alone is claimed as new.
title: Complete binary convolution-rank census on the five-by-five affine plane
